An explicit supervisor decision requires current native manage+team, account-bound analyst, write-scoped assignment, locked enrollment/assignment, exact reviewed revision and bounded reason. Dependencies are revalidated after locks.

Only pending steps stop through the original native stop transition. Original actor, immutable source/review snapshots, applied receipts and v1 execution paths are preserved. Audit records current supervisor and canonical reviewed analyst. No impersonation or future execution authority is fabricated.

Existing team panel opens a native popup even when the analyst has no current allocation rows. It supports pagination/customer navigation/read-only roles, explicit stop review, retained conflict drafts, last-page recovery, identity/revocation clearing and no stale change emission during refresh. Team counters reload on popup close so successive reviews remain available.
